complete_pair_palette.completeness_argument: A facet of P_t-P_u exposes a sum of two faces with total affine span dimension2. If one exposed face has dimension2, its normal is a face normal of one owner. Otherwise both exposed faces are edges with independent directions, and the facet normal is their cross product. These actual edges, both exact owner frames, all face normals and every edge cross product were enumerated; zero products excluded exactly. The retained normals are precisely candidates exposing a two-dimensional sum face for at least one pair. Hence every pair-difference-body facet direction is retained.

construction.source_proof:
Balanced marked row source, 15 October 2026.

Continue the reviewed half-step source, retaining axial vector a=(d,0,0), full-height vector c=(0,0,H), and word type i+j+k modulo2. Let b=(x,h,0). The displacement b flips type; b-a preserves it. In each case both initial owner types are checked with the complete ordered fixed-frame difference-body palette.

The prior source identifies an actual opposite-type support normal n_o and same-type support normal n_s. Solve the coupled equations n_o.b=H_o and n_s.(b-a)=H_s. Both share the same x,h and same axial return d. The canonical field solution is exact. For AP4, d=(1+sqrt(2))/2, x=(-2+3sqrt(2))/4 and h=(6-sqrt(2))/4. All four b,b-a ordered bonds lie on their complete difference-body boundaries. Literal convex combinations of complete canonical vertices give the common contact points; no touching claim rests on a supporting plane alone.

The a bonds retain the exact axial contact. All remaining planar words separate by the horizontal enclosing circles: when j=0, abs(i)>=2 gives abs(X)>=2d>2R; when abs(j)=1, words other than the two adjacent bonds give abs(X)>=min(d+x,2d-x)>2R; when abs(j)>=2, abs(Y)>=2h>2R. Every exact tail gap is positive in the saved canonical fields. Different integer height levels have disjoint complete height interiors, and c flips the type while2c restores it. The full source is therefore an infinite packing of complete owners.

The AP4 planar area is d*h=(4+5sqrt(2))/8, strictly less than the retained rhombic area sqrt(2), by (4-3sqrt(2))/8<0. It also improves the reviewed half-step area. This is a source comparison only, not a finite record or optimal density claim. AP6 and AP12 equation solutions remain valid whole-owner sources, but some selected support-plane equalities cease to be actual contacts because another difference-body facet is strictly separating. Their contact decoders explicitly mark actual_contact=false, and their areas remain worse than their rhombic controls. Preserve these partial contact-closure failures; do not label them fully contact-balanced sources.

For every finite word set, preserve the exact centers B*(i,j,k), type i+j+k, and both endpoint costs. The x endpoints are min/max(i*d+j*x) minus/plus R; y endpoints min/max(j*h) minus/plus R; z endpoints min/max(k*H) minus/plus H/2. Each host-wall support is the maximum over these same whole owners, including the actual type's support vertices. The source may be translated only as one common state unless a later finite construction supplies its own complete compatibility proof.

The first AP4 equation solution was saved before the exploratory AP6 full-contact assertion failed. Its bytes remain unchanged. The completed derivation now retains AP6/AP12 as valid but partially noncontact controls, with the distinction above. Source proof, finite witnesses and native restoration have separate review scopes.

contribution.method:
This is an explicit replacement archive for 23 previously submitted cases, adding zero new distinct campaign cases. SUPERSESSIONS.json identifies the prior issue, archive, native hash and certified scale for each case. Ten replacements improve the pinned current nominal/reference bound; thirteen improve the complete native certificate without claiming a new ideal nominal value.

These complete constructions combine forced-phase prism-to-antiprism ring/slot inclusion, literal whole-owner prefixes, prism column and height/collar transfers, and retained whole-row returns. Every source has a full physical decoder with actual owner centers and frames. Certificate improvements arise from these physical operations; their narrower numerical scope is retained explicitly.

All active witnesses passed independent source, full geometry and current-public/private comparison review, followed by both official checks on the packaged native files. The archive preserves the complete source chain, original donor attribution, reviewed intermediate packings and explicit supersession identities. Some provenance audit scripts require the authenticated upstream Git snapshot or reviewed-source registry; the bundled official native validators are directly replayable.

Credit the new finite constructions exactly to PingYou Ltd. Original donors and their authors remain credited. These contributions may be published under the repository’s MIT license. No global optimum is claimed. Please treat these as stronger replacements, not as 23 additional distinct cases.
